title: Video explains the world's most important 6-sec drum loop
summary: Nate Harrison's 2004 video history of the Amen Break, a six-second drum sample from a 1969 b-side that became the basis of hip-hop sampling, jungle and drum and bass. It is also a meditation on cultural ownership and creativity.
why: A perennial HN recommendation, brought up whenever sampling, copyright or music history comes up, often described as a must-watch.

quote.text: this is an excellent 20-minute video about the history of the Amen Break
